name: Exp_ColorNonLagDotMACD
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorNonLagDotMACD custom indicator, offering four distinct signal algorithms: zero-line breakout, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD-signal line crossover. It opens and closes positions on new bar events with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorNonLagDotMACD自定义指标进行交易，提供四种不同的信号算法：零线突破、MACD方向变化、信号线方向变化以及MACD与信号线交叉。它在新K线出现时开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于NonLagDotMACD指标，这是一种改进型MACD指标，通过减少滞后性来提高信号时效性。策略提供四种入场模式：零线突破模式检测MACD柱状图穿越零线；MACD转向模式检测MACD值的方向反转；信号线转向模式检测信号线本身的方向变化；MACD交叉模式则是经典的MACD与信号线交叉策略。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定点数的止损和止盈作为保护。仓位管理采用MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示账户余额的百分比份额。EA仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐Tick重复计算，提高了执行效率。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the NonLagDotMACD indicator, an improved MACD variant that reduces lag to enhance signal timeliness. The EA provides four entry modes: zero-line breakout detects MACD histogram crossing zero; MACD twist detects reversal in MACD value direction; signal twist detects direction change of the signal line itself; and MACD disposition is the classic MACD-signal line crossover. Exit conditions are triggered by opposite signals closing positions, supplemented by fixed-point stop loss and take profit as protection. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a percentage share of the account balance. The EA calculates signals only on new bar formation, avoiding redundant per-tick computation and improving execution efficiency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易份额或手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative value = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 提供四种不同的信号算法模式，策略灵活性强
仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐Tick重复运算，效率高
具有独立的买卖开仓和平仓权限控制，风险管理粒度细
使用NonLagDot改进型MACD指标，减少信号滞后性
包含止损和止盈保护机制，基础风险控制到位
pros_en: Offers four distinct signal algorithm modes, providing strong strategy flexibility
Calculates signals only on new bar formation, avoiding redundant per-tick computation for high efficiency
Features independent buy/sell open and close permission controls for granular risk management
Uses the NonLagDot improved MACD indicator to reduce signal lag
Includes stop loss and take profit protection mechanisms with basic risk control in place
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能导致较大单笔亏损
没有扩展点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不透明
缺乏仓位检查和最大持仓限制，可能同时开多个同向仓位
MM参数为-0.1时固定0.1手，没有根据账户规模动态调整
cons_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large, potentially leading to significant per-trade losses
No spread filter included, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Depends on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, making core trading logic opaque
Lacks position checking and maximum position limits, potentially opening multiple same-direction positions simultaneously
MM parameter at -0.1 fixes 0.1 lots without dynamic adjustment based on account size
improvements: 添加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，增强风控能力
将核心交易函数从外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh内联或重构为自包含逻辑，提高透明度和可维护性
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and maximum position count limits to enhance risk control capabilities
Inline or refactor core trading functions from the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh into self-contained logic to improve transparency and maintainability

risk_points: 依赖外部不透明的TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，其平仓和开仓逻辑中是否有仓位重复检查未知
默认止损1000点较大，在小周期或高波动品种上可能造成显著亏损
无点差过滤机制，在高点差时段可能产生不利入场
risk_points_en: Depends on the opaque external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library; whether it checks for duplicate positions in open/close logic is unknown
Default 1000-point stop loss is large and could cause significant losses on small timeframes or volatile instruments
No spread filter mechanism, which may produce unfavorable entries during high-spread periods

It opens and closes positions on new bar events with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
